system.description:
Known as "scrounging" in some parts of the world. This Skill bolsters your ability to search the clutter within the dungeon to find interesting bits of rubbish and maybe something useful. Using this Skill takes 1 hour and can only be performed once per 50-foot-square area. Make an Unopposed Skill Check.

On Success, you find what you were looking for or another interesting item, determined by the GM.

upgrades.description: You also find 1 Rank damage die's-worth of Misc. Junk.
A Dumpster Dive takes 30 minutes. On a Critical Hit, you gain an additional interesting item.
A Dumpster Dive takes 10 minutes. On an Amazing Success, you gain an interesting item.
